effect_description_eng: [Main] You may play 1 [Kurata's Army] trait Tamer card from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area. [All Turns] When any Digimon on the field are deleted, ＜Delay＞. ・1 of your Tamers may digivolve into a [Kurata's Army] trait Digimon card in the hand or trash without paying the cost.
security_effect_description_eng: [Security] You may play 1 play cost 5 or lower [Kurata's Army] trait card from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
